description: This file defines the ScreenStringRenderer interface for rendering various components of a screen in the OFBiz widget framework, including methods for rendering screen sections, containers, content, sub-content, and portal pages.

classes.name: ScreenStringRenderer
classes.description: Interface for rendering screen components in OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: getRendererName
methods.description: Returns the name of the renderer.

methods.name: renderScreenBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a screen.

methods.name: renderScreenEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a screen.

methods.name: renderSectionBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a section.

methods.name: renderSectionEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a section.

methods.name: renderContainerBegin
methods.description: Renders the beginning of a container.

methods.name: renderContainerEnd
methods.description: Renders the end of a container.

methods.name: renderScreenletSubWidget
methods.description: Renders a sub-widget within a screenlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPageColumnEnd
methods.description: Ends rendering a portal page column.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBegin
methods.description: Begins rendering a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletBody
methods.description: Renders the body of a portal page portlet.

methods.name: renderPortalPagePortletEnd
methods.description: Ends rendering a portal page portlet.
